name: D02_diamond_prisms
motion_prompt: Locked-off wide camera. Large clear diamond prisms frame a black central void. The faceted crystals rotate very slowly by a few degrees and back, producing smoothly traveling champagne, icy blue and violet internal reflections. Crisp rigid geometry, restrained high-jewelry lighting, deep clean blacks. Continuous hypnotic refraction cycle, no sudden bright flashes, no explosions, no camera movement or cuts.
processing: Wan 2.2 first/last frame, 81 frames at 16 fps; crop 2 px top/bottom; optical-flow interpolation to 60 fps; cosine time remap forward then reverse over one 8-second cycle, delivered at 30 fps. Eased reversals avoid a hard cut or a tail-to-head dissolve. ProRes LT master and all-intra H.264 delivery.
